about: C1 sanitising, one truth in two languages (plan 5, v3.1 addendum, row 18). Generated by tests/fixtures/c1-sanitise.gen.ts from server/core/loops.ts, the reference;
server/tests/loops.test.ts and server/jobs/test_open_loops.py both run every case. Field names are the line's own (snake_case).
lines: input fields -> expected fields after sanitising -> the composed line; parsing the line gives the expected fields back.
refused: compose must refuse the input with an error mentioning `because`. unreadable: parse must not read the claim.

rules.text: sanitise(text, cap): delete every '|'; replace each unsafe character with a space; collapse every run of whitespace to one space; trim; keep the first `cap` code points; trim again.
rules.id: clean_id: delete every unsafe character, every '|', every ',' and all whitespace; keep the first 100 code points. Used for key, client, type, channel_id, opened, reopened, by_message, closed, by_user, resolved, until and each evidence id.
rules.unsafe: general category Cc (control) and Cs (lone surrogate halves), U+2028, U+2029, U+200E, U+200F, U+202A to U+202E, U+2066 to U+2069
rules.whitespace: JavaScript's \s: U+0009 to U+000D, U+0020, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000 to U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000, U+FEFF (note U+FEFF, which Python's str.isspace does not count)
rules.evidence: clean each id, drop blanks, drop repeats keeping the first sighting, keep the last 8 in the order given; written comma-separated
rules.reopened: null when blank or '-' after cleaning; written as '-'
rules.times: ISO 8601 beginning YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date that exists (2026-02-30 is refused), and a time JavaScript's Date.parse reads
rules.line: TAG/1 then name=value pairs in the order of `lines` below, joined by ' | '
